title: NLU Action Object
description: Versioned, structured result emitted by the NLU + LLM middleware for one user utterance. This is the integration contract between the NLU layer and any downstream consumer (request-builder / payment orchestration / bank API adapter). The NLU layer is responsible ONLY for understanding the utterance and resolving the beneficiary; it does NOT authenticate the user, enforce business limits, build the bank payload, or execute the transaction.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of THIS contract. Consumers must pin a major version. Bumped on any breaking field change.

text.description: The raw user utterance the result was derived from (for audit/trace).

language.description: Detected (or hinted) language of the utterance.

intent.description: The recognised intent. This enum is the shared source of truth agreed with Product.

status.description: Actionability of this result. Only 'complete' results are safe to hand to the request-builder; the rest require another turn or are non-transactional.

entities.description: Slots extracted for the intent. Fields present depend on the intent; unrelated fields are null/omitted.

amount.description: Numeric amount (transfer or bill). Decimal value, > 0 when present.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code (e.g. 'SAR', 'USD'). Defaults to SAR when omitted by the user.

recipient.description: transfer_money: the raw recipient name as extracted from the utterance (before beneficiary resolution).

source_account.description: Optional 'from' account the user named. Authoritative source-account context should come from the authenticated session, not here.

biller.description: pay_bill: the biller as the user referred to it.

biller_category.description: pay_bill: canonical biller category when recognised (e.g. 'telecom').

biller_code.description: pay_bill: resolved SADAD biller code (e.g. '001') when known.

biller_name.description: pay_bill: resolved SADAD biller display name when known.

reference_number.description: pay_bill: bill / subscriber / account reference number.

note.description: Optional free-text note attached to the instruction.

resolved_beneficiary.description: Authoritative beneficiary resolved via the beneficiary/account-details lookup. Takes precedence over any name-based match. Null when not resolved or not applicable.

llm_assisted.description: True when the LLM fallback filled or corrected slots for this result.

clarification.description: Natural-language follow-up to show the user when status = needs_clarification.
